title: Fluency: adding pieces of different sizes

families.prompt: Work out $\tfrac{{{a}}}{{{b}}} + \tfrac{{{c}}}{{{d}}}$ as a fraction in its lowest terms.

wrong.line: You added the tops and the bottoms. Rename both over ${cd}$ first, then add the tops only.
You put both over ${cd}$ but kept the old tops: $\tfrac{{{a}}}{{{b}}}$ is $\tfrac{{{u}}}{{{cd}}}$ and $\tfrac{{{c}}}{{{d}}}$ is $\tfrac{{{w}}}{{{cd}}}$.

solution: Rename both over ${cd}$, a size both fit into: $\tfrac{{{a}}}{{{b}}} + \tfrac{{{c}}}{{{d}}} = \tfrac{{{u}}}{{{cd}}} + \tfrac{{{w}}}{{{cd}}} = \tfrac{{{p}}}{{{cd}}}$.

families.prompt: Work out $\tfrac{{{a}}}{{{b}}} - \tfrac{{{c}}}{{{d}}}$ as a fraction in its lowest terms.

wrong.line: You took away the tops and the bottoms. Rename both over ${cd}$ first, then take away the tops only.
wrong.when: a > c and b > d and (a - c)/(b - d) != a/b - c/d

wrong.line: You put both over ${cd}$ but kept the old tops: $\tfrac{{{a}}}{{{b}}}$ is $\tfrac{{{u}}}{{{cd}}}$ and $\tfrac{{{c}}}{{{d}}}$ is $\tfrac{{{w}}}{{{cd}}}$.

solution: Rename both over ${cd}$, a size both fit into: $\tfrac{{{a}}}{{{b}}} - \tfrac{{{c}}}{{{d}}} = \tfrac{{{u}}}{{{cd}}} - \tfrac{{{w}}}{{{cd}}} = \tfrac{{{p}}}{{{cd}}}$.
